title: weave-record/1 container manifest
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for manifest.json of a weave-record/1 container (CONTRACT 11.2). This document also carries the shared $defs reused by envelope.json, ref.json and the kind schemas, plus $defs.manifest_attestation for signatures/manifest.sig.json (CONTRACT 11.3). Rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by tools/check_schemas.py and listed in schemas/README.md.

origin.title: origin
origin.description: Project slug plus the publishing instance key id (CONTRACT 5). Shared by the record envelope, references and the manifest.

key_id.title: key id
key_id.description: ed25519: + the first 32 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the 32-byte raw RFC 8032 public key (CONTRACT 3.4).

digest.title: digest string
digest.description: sha256: followed by exactly 64 lowercase hex characters (CONTRACT 3.6). H0 only registers sha256 in structurally checked manifest positions.

timestamp.title: timestamp literal
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC with exactly three fractional digits and literal Z, years 0000-9999, seconds 00-59 (CONTRACT 0; no leap second). Calendar validity is not expressible; see schemas/README.md.

kind_name.title: kind name
kind_name.description: Registered or opaque kind name (CONTRACT 7): dot/dash separated lowercase segments, at most 128 ASCII bytes.

record_id.title: record id
record_id.description: 1-256 Unicode scalar values, no C0/C1/DEL control characters, no leading or trailing U+0020 (CONTRACT 5). Lone surrogates cannot be rejected by JSON Schema; see schemas/README.md.

public_key.title: Ed25519 public key
public_key.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of the 32-byte raw RFC 8032 public key: 43 characters, final character constrained to the alphabet that leaves the two unused bits zero (CONTRACT 3.5).

signature_value.title: Ed25519 signature value
signature_value.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of a 64-byte Ed25519 signature: 86 characters, final character constrained to the alphabet that leaves the four unused bits zero (CONTRACT 3.5).

signature.title: signature entry
signature.description: One per-record or manifest signature (CONTRACT 5.2 / 11.3). Ordering by key and per-key uniqueness are enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

signatures.title: signature set
signatures.description: Non-empty array of 1-16 signatures (CONTRACT 5.2). Sorted by key ascending with unique keys; enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

manifest_record.title: manifest record entry
manifest_record.description: One entry of manifest.records (CONTRACT 11.2). Entries are sorted by digest ascending and digests are unique; enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

previous_manifest.title: previous manifest reference
previous_manifest.description: Digest of the previous container manifest (CONTRACT 11.2 / D1).

chain.title: internal chain head
chain.description: L1/L2 internal hash-chain claim (CONTRACT 11.2 / A1c). Offline verification cannot recompute it; a verifier reports it unverified.

blob.title: blob entry
blob.description: One content-addressed blob entry of manifest.blobs (CONTRACT 11.2). Sorted by digest ascending with unique digests; enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

manifest_timestamp.title: manifest timestamp entry
manifest_timestamp.description: One L2 RFC 3161 timestamp receipt listed by signatures/manifest.sig.json (CONTRACT 11.3). Sorted by path ascending; enforced by tools/check_schemas.py.

manifest_attestation.title: manifest signature file
manifest_attestation.description: Shape of signatures/manifest.sig.json (CONTRACT 11.3). The digest binds the exact manifest.json canonical bytes, never manifest.json itself. timestamps is always present (an empty array for L0/L1, at least one entry for L2); whether the list is compatible with manifest.level is a cross-file rule that JSON Schema cannot express.
